positioning: ARIA is being built as a sovereign-grade defence intelligence platform. Today it combines live OSINT, sanctions, procurement, vault-curated sources and structured DD into evidence-graded reports, with source health and confidence visible on every material finding.

claims.label: Sovereign-grade roadmap
claims.public_wording: Sovereign-grade roadmap; cloud-assisted today; private and sovereign specialist modes are the independence path.
required_to_call_complete: Production router exposes a configured sovereign model path
Landing page distinguishes sovereign mode from cloud-assisted mode
Capability card reports which model class served the output

claims.label: Evidence-graded DD
claims.public_wording: Structured DD reports expose quality grade, source tiering, confidence and blockers.
required_to_call_complete: Every DD report view renders quality_assessment
Grade-A blockers are visible before export
Partial reports cannot be presented as complete

claims.label: Live source health
claims.public_wording: Live OSINT, sanctions, procurement and vault-curated sources are monitored with source-health scoring.
required_to_call_complete: Source health is visible on dashboard and sources page
Degraded sources are excluded or down-weighted in confirmed findings
Reliability below threshold is visible to the user

claims.label: Vault-curated sources
claims.public_wording: User/admin-added vault sites feed curated source monitoring without duplicating built-in ARIA source monitors.
required_to_call_complete: Vault website scrape reaches dashboard output
Vault sources remain distinct from built-in source uptime monitors

claims.label: Audit-verifiable reports
claims.public_wording: PDF reports can be signed and verified when the report-signing key is configured.
required_to_call_complete: Unsigned exports carry a visible warning
Verification endpoint is reachable and documented
